system.description:
You infuse medical chakra into yourself as you release it as an aura of cleansing energy.

You release a potent wave of medical release chakra. All creatures within range who are currently under the effects of a Mental or Sensory conditions as a result of a jutsu of equal rank or lower, has 1 rank of each condition type removed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. Listed conditions inflicted by jutsu of equal rank or lower are removed.
